column3: US-01 Register and log in with email or Google
column4:
As a user, I want to register and log in with email or Google.

Acceptance criteria: Password ≥ 8 chars or Google; wrong password shows an error; no other user’s data is ever returned

Use case: UC-01 · MoSCoW: Must · Release: S1

Sprint 1 refinement (v1.1): also log out; account locked for 15 min after 5 failed logins (NFR-04).

column3: US-06 Delete my account and all my photos and data
column4:
As a user, I want to delete my account and all my photos and data.

Acceptance criteria: Double confirmation; all data and photos deleted within 24 h

Use case: UC-01 · MoSCoW: Must · Release: S1

column3: US-08 Add a piece by taking or uploading a photo
column4:
As a user, I want to add a piece by taking or uploading a photo.

Acceptance criteria: JPG/PNG/HEIC ≤ 10 MB stored and shown as the piece’s image

Use case: UC-03 · MoSCoW: Must · Release: S1

column3: US-09 Enter category, colour, fabric, season, size, style, dress code
column4:
As a user, I want to enter category, colour, fabric, season, size, style, dress code.

Acceptance criteria: Values from 3.1; category, colour and ≥ 1 dress-code level required

Use case: UC-03 · MoSCoW: Must · Release: S1

column3: US-11 Review and edit every detail before saving
column4:
As a user, I want to review and edit every detail before saving.

Acceptance criteria: One review screen; the piece exists only after Save

Use case: UC-03 · MoSCoW: Must · Release: S1

column3: US-12 Browse and filter my closet by category and status
column4:
As a user, I want to browse and filter my closet by category and status.

Acceptance criteria: Filters combine; counts update

Use case: UC-04 · MoSCoW: Must · Release: S1

column3: US-71 Edit a piece’s details later
column4:
As a user, I want to edit a piece’s details later.

Acceptance criteria: Changes appear in all outfits and filters

Use case: UC-04 · MoSCoW: Must · Release: S1

column3: US-15 Put a piece in the laundry basket and take it out
column4:
As a user, I want to put a piece in the laundry basket and take it out.

Acceptance criteria: One tap each way; basket lists all Laundry pieces

Use case: UC-06 · MoSCoW: Must · Release: S1

column3: US-16 Return everything with one “Wash done” tap
column4:
As a user, I want to return everything with one “Wash done” tap.

Acceptance criteria: All Laundry pieces become Available

Use case: UC-06 · MoSCoW: Should · Release: S1

column3: US-56 Set a status per piece (5 statuses)
column4:
As a user, I want to set a status per piece (5 statuses).

Acceptance criteria: Exactly one status, shown as a badge

Use case: UC-06 · MoSCoW: Must · Release: S1

column3: US-02 Answer a short style quiz: styles, colours, occasions
column4:
As a user, I want to answer a short style quiz: styles, colours, occasions.

Acceptance criteria: ≤ 4 steps, skippable; answers change the first recommendation

Use case: UC-02 · MoSCoW: Must · Release: S1

Sprint 1 scope: quiz answers are saved to the profile. "Answers change the first recommendation" is verified in Sprint 2 with US-19.

column3: US-03 Set my usual dress code and a modest preference
column4:
As a user, I want to set my usual dress code and a modest preference.

Acceptance criteria: One of the 5 levels; with modest on, no non-modest piece appears anywhere

Use case: UC-02 · MoSCoW: Must · Release: S1

Sprint 1 scope: dress code and modest preference saved; each piece stores a modest flag. Filtering outfits by them is verified in Sprint 2 with US-21.

column3: US-04 Set my city so outfits use my local weather
column4:
As a user, I want to set my city so outfits use my local weather.

Acceptance criteria: Forecast on Home is for that city

Use case: UC-02 · MoSCoW: Must · Release: S1

Sprint 1 scope: city saved to the profile. "Forecast on Home is for that city" is verified in Sprint 2 with US-20 (weather API).

column3: US-46 Add events by hand and see them in a calendar
column4:
As a user, I want to add events by hand and see them in a calendar.

Acceptance criteria: Title, date, time and one occasion; month view

Use case: UC-10 · MoSCoW: Must · Release: S1

column3: US-64 See closet gaps by category and dress code
column4:
As a user, I want to see closet gaps by category and dress code.

Acceptance criteria: Gap = ≤ 1 piece at a level the user dresses for

Use case: UC-14 · MoSCoW: Could · Release: S1

column3: US-61 Hide a piece for 7 days without it being a dislike
column4:
As a user, I want to hide a piece for 7 days without it being a dislike.

Acceptance criteria: Returns after 7 days; rejection count unchanged

Use case: UC-09 · MoSCoW: Should · Release: S1

Moved from Sprint 1 to Sprint 2 (v1.1): it hides a piece from recommendations, which are built in Sprint 2.

column3: US-80 Suspend or reactivate a user account (Admin)
column4:
As an admin, I want to suspend or reactivate a user account.

Acceptance criteria: Admin searches by email, sees status and counts but never photos; suspended user cannot sign in; every admin action is logged; non-admin gets 403.

Use case: Administration · MoSCoW: Should · Added in v1.1 after Milestone 1 feedback (Admin actor missing).

column3: US-81 See system health and usage totals (Admin)
column4:
As an admin, I want to see system health and usage totals.

Acceptance criteria: Uptime, error rate, fallback counts, totals only; no individual data.

Use case: Administration · MoSCoW: Could · Added in v1.1 after Milestone 1 feedback (Admin actor missing).

column3: US-82 Complete a user's export or deletion request (Admin)
column4:
As an admin, I want to complete a user's export or deletion request.

Acceptance criteria: Runs the same deletion as US-06; recorded in the audit log.

Use case: Administration · MoSCoW: Could · Added in v1.1 after Milestone 1 feedback (Admin actor missing).

column3: US-83 Manage app lists and feature switches (Admin)
column4:
As an admin, I want to manage app lists and feature switches.

Acceptance criteria: Categories, dress codes, occasions; switch AI chat off when the LLM is down.

Use case: Administration · MoSCoW: Could · Added in v1.1 after Milestone 1 feedback (Admin actor missing).

column3: US-84 Set my laundry basket time and laundry day
column4:
As a user, I want to set my laundry basket time and laundry day.

Acceptance criteria: 1 – 14 days; each Laundry piece shows when it is back; with auto-return it becomes Available after that time (logged); laundry day on the calendar with a reminder the day before

Use case: UC-06 · MoSCoW: Should · Release: Sprint 2

Added in SRS v1.2 (change C-17) after the second design review. Built early as a preview with tests; accepted at its own sprint review. Not Sprint 1 work.

column3: US-85 Set a recycle time so the same clothes are not suggested again too soon
column4:
As a user, I want to set a recycle time so the same clothes are not suggested again too soon.

Acceptance criteria: 0 – 30 days; a top, bottom or dress worn in the last N days is not suggested; shoes, bags and accessories may repeat; 0 = no limit

Use case: UC-19 · MoSCoW: Should · Release: Sprint 2

Added in SRS v1.2 (change C-17) after the second design review. Built early as a preview with tests; accepted at its own sprint review. Not Sprint 1 work.

column3: US-86 Add a return date and note to a borrowed, packed or unavailable piece
column4:
As a user, I want to add a return date and note to a borrowed, packed or unavailable piece.

Acceptance criteria: Date not in the past; note ≤ 60 characters; shown on the piece, the calendar and in reminders; cleared when Available

Use case: UC-06 · MoSCoW: Should · Release: Sprint 2

Added in SRS v1.2 (change C-17) after the second design review. Built early as a preview with tests; accepted at its own sprint review. Not Sprint 1 work.

column3: US-87 Import my calendar and see wardrobe dates on it
column4:
As a user, I want to import my calendar and see wardrobe dates on it.

Acceptance criteria: .ics from Google, Outlook or Apple; future events only; occasion guessed from the title; no duplicates; calendar marks laundry day, pieces back, borrowed due, packed; future-date plans count pieces back by then

Use case: UC-10 · MoSCoW: Should · Release: Sprint 2

Added in SRS v1.2 (change C-17) after the second design review. Built early as a preview with tests; accepted at its own sprint review. Not Sprint 1 work.

column3: US-88 Ask “Do I need this?” before buying a piece
column4:
As a user, I want to ask “Do I need this?” before buying a piece.

Acceptance criteria: Verdict from similar pieces owned, new complete outfits it would make, and deletion reasons

Use case: UC-14 · MoSCoW: Could · Release: Sprint 3

Added in SRS v1.2 (change C-17) after the second design review. Built early as a preview with tests; accepted at its own sprint review. Not Sprint 1 work.

column3: US-79 Be warned if a planned piece becomes unavailable
column4:
As a user, I want to be warned if a planned piece becomes unavailable.

Acceptance criteria: Warning with a one-tap swap; a piece back before the event is not a conflict; a piece planned for two events < 4 h apart is flagged

Use case: UC-10 · MoSCoW: Could · Release: Sprint 2

Added in SRS v1.1 (v1.3 product requirements, change C-28 – C-34). Built early as a labelled preview with tests; accepted at its own sprint review. Not Sprint 1 work.

column3: US-90 Use one-tap occasion templates
column4:
As a user, I want to use one-tap occasion templates.

Acceptance criteria: 9 templates (University, Work, Dinner, Wedding, Casual outing, Formal event, Travel, Gym, Interview) set occasion, dress code and style; every value can still be changed

Use case: UC-09 · MoSCoW: Should · Release: Sprint 2

Added in SRS v1.1 (v1.3 product requirements, change C-28 – C-34). Built early as a labelled preview with tests; accepted at its own sprint review. Not Sprint 1 work.

column3: US-91 See my outfit history
column4:
As a user, I want to see my outfit history.

Acceptance criteria: Each “Wear this” shows date, occasion, pieces, rating, weather and wear count; filter by date range, occasion and minimum rating

Use case: UC-13 · MoSCoW: Should · Release: Sprint 2

Added in SRS v1.1 (v1.3 product requirements, change C-28 – C-34). Built early as a labelled preview with tests; accepted at its own sprint review. Not Sprint 1 work.

column3: US-93 See my account activity
column4:
As a user, I want to see my account activity.

Acceptance criteria: Sign-ins, profile changes, pieces added/edited/deleted, status changes, Wash done, events, packing and learned-preference decisions, newest first; only the owner sees it

Use case: UC-01 · MoSCoW: Should · Release: Sprint 2

Added in SRS v1.1 (v1.3 product requirements, change C-28 – C-34). Built early as a labelled preview with tests; accepted at its own sprint review. Not Sprint 1 work.

column3: US-65 Get a duplicate-purchase warning
column4:
As a user, I want to get a duplicate-purchase warning.

Acceptance criteria: Similarity 0 – 100 from category, colour, style, formality and season, ≥ 70 = similar; “You already own N similar …”; Buy anyway, Ask Closet, View similar items

Use case: UC-14 · MoSCoW: Could · Release: Sprint 3

Added in SRS v1.1 (v1.3 product requirements, change C-28 – C-34). Built early as a labelled preview with tests; accepted at its own sprint review. Not Sprint 1 work.

column3: US-89 See a Wardrobe Health score
column4:
As a user, I want to see a Wardrobe Health score.

Acceptance criteria: 0 – 100 from five parts minus two penalties, every part listed with its points; empty closet → 0 with a message; up to 3 actions

Use case: UC-13 · MoSCoW: Could · Release: Sprint 3

Added in SRS v1.1 (v1.3 product requirements, change C-28 – C-34). Built early as a labelled preview with tests; accepted at its own sprint review. Not Sprint 1 work.

column3: US-92 See every notice in one Notification Center
column4:
As a user, I want to see every notice in one Notification Center.

Acceptance criteria: Conflicts, event tomorrow without an outfit, borrowed piece due, laundry day, rain, packing not done, Wash done, forgotten piece; read/unread; at most 3 highlighted

Use case: UC-21 · MoSCoW: Could · Release: Sprint 3

Added in SRS v1.1 (v1.3 product requirements, change C-28 – C-34). Built early as a labelled preview with tests; accepted at its own sprint review. Not Sprint 1 work.

column3: US-68 Packing assistant for trips
column4:
As a user, I want to pack for a trip.

Acceptance criteria: Destination, dates, trip type, activities → one outfit per day re-using pieces; counts, missing outfits, weather warnings; Mark as packed sets each piece to Packed until the day after the trip

Use case: UC-20 · MoSCoW: Could · Release: Stretch

Added in SRS v1.1 (v1.3 product requirements, change C-28 – C-34). Built early as a labelled preview with tests; accepted at its own sprint review. Not Sprint 1 work.

column3: US-19 Choose an occasion and a style and get 3 outfits
column4:
As a user, I want to choose an occasion and a style and get 3 outfits.

Core flow (rev. 2): three looks shown visually with name, pieces, occasion, style, weather, explanation and actions. Built early as a labelled preview with tests; accepted at its own sprint review. Not Sprint 1 work.

column3: US-24 Change one of the 4 pieces from a list of alternatives
column4:
As a user, I want to change one of the 4 pieces from a list of alternatives.

Core flow (rev. 2): only that slot changes; the rest of the look stays (API-R04, API-CF01). Built early as a labelled preview with tests; accepted at its own sprint review. Not Sprint 1 work.

column3: US-13 Remove a piece and give a reason: Torn / damaged, Became too small, No longer my style, Other
column4:
As a user, I want to remove a piece and give a reason: Torn / damaged, Became too small, No longer my style, Other.

Revision 2 (C-50 – C-57): a reason is required and decides the effect (BR-10). Built early as a labelled preview with tests; accepted at its own sprint review. Not Sprint 1 work.

column3: US-27 See an outfit on an avatar before wearing it
column4:
As a user, I want to see an outfit on an avatar before wearing it.

Revision 2: virtual try-on opens from any of the three looks, including a changed piece (FR-76). Release corrected to Sprint 3 (C-57). Built early as a labelled preview with tests; accepted at its own sprint review. Not Sprint 1 work.

column3: US-33 Have torn and too-small pieces replaced on my shopping list
column4:
As a user, I want to have torn and too-small pieces replaced on my shopping list.

Revision 2: Torn / damaged → replacement; Became too small → replacement in the next size (FR-72). Built early as a labelled preview with tests; accepted at its own sprint review. Not Sprint 1 work.

column3: US-34 Have “no longer my style” pieces never treated as replacements and learned from
column4:
As a user, I want to have “no longer my style” pieces never treated as replacements and learned from.

Revision 2: never suggested again; two in one style → learned pattern with Confirm / Undo (FR-73). Built early as a labelled preview with tests; accepted at its own sprint review. Not Sprint 1 work.

column3: US-36 Keep a shopping list, also from Ask Closet
column4:
As a user, I want to keep a shopping list, also from Ask Closet.

Revision 2: sources Ask Closet, replacement, gap, suggestion; labels; similar-owned warning (FR-61, FR-74). Built early as a labelled preview with tests; accepted at its own sprint review. Not Sprint 1 work.
